player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} ({piece}). Imiraz nniḍen d ({opp}). Ssawel imirazen am '[b1 c3]' (si → ɣer). Imirazen akken i d-kečč n tsekkirt n ccix.
Kul tɣimit tesseɣret {score_per_capture} n uṭṭun. Urar ad tagg ara s {max_moves} n imirazen neɣ mi ara imiraz ur yesɛi ara imiraz leḥḥal / ur yesɛi ara imirazen. Aṭṭun uɛḍil iɣellem.

invalid_move.own_piece: Ur yezmir ara ad yeɣli ɣef tferka-s.
